dimensions.name: Governance Awareness
dimensions.rationale: Every step in the pattern lifecycle flow loaded governance rules and executed with 100% schema validation across all 15 reasoning spans. Schema compliance was maintained from initial context loading through multiple parallel reference architecture generation tasks without any validation faults.

dimensions.name: Causal Reasoning Depth
dimensions.rationale: The causal pipeline demonstrated an end-to-end progression: extracting agentic and structural pattern signals, deriving concrete pattern proposals, classifying architectural scope, evaluating lifecycle promotion recommendations, and deriving concrete reference architectures.

dimensions.name: Architectural Tension Analysis
dimensions.rationale: The scope classifier and promotion workflow systematically evaluated tradeoffs between structural and agentic patterns, establishing scope boundaries and validating governance criteria before delegating to modular reference architecture generation instances.
